resume protocol.why: The resume protocol carries every rule a resumed session needs, so it runs over the soft budget: scoped approvals in step 4 with the explicit-gate list, the effect-absent check and the production rule; the run-own-commands rule of step 1 with the foreign-tag rule; the [idle] line with the check of the messages kept after the summary (the summary is written without them, so its Step 1 can be stale), its ≤3-line idle report and step 5's away digest, whose first line is the Basis line code renders at delivery (listed steps marked done, units running, commits not pushed or no upstream, files changed; at most 113 chars); the [idle-again] note of a person's return (do not redo what the background turn did); the [idle-done] line of a finished or blocked lane (never with [idle], [idle-halt], [midturn] or [driver]); the [driver] re-enter line, kept only beside a measured Active driver and never with [idle-halt] (its condition names the workflow file a GSD loop command loads, which compaction does not restore in full); step 5's unblocked Next steps with every open ask repeated at the end of the turn; the one-line handoff ack ([handoff-ack] beside [handoff] when code saw the report unsent, filled by code so the model copies no placeholder, and the same form for [handoff-partial]'s receipt); the [question] line, which quotes a question a main turn ended on that no person's turn has followed (at most 240 chars, question.ts QUESTION_MAX), because a compaction soon after a timed-out dialog buried the unanswered question; the [auto-mode] line, kept only in auto permission mode, which names the classes the classifier still blocks with a valid carried approval (a force-push, history rewrite, branch or tag delete or external write); the [resumed] first line before any tool call (at most 118 chars), step 6's no-dialog-after-a-timeout clause and the [question-timeout] note; and both step-4 lines saying the gate asks even when an approval carries and which branches count as protected, by name wherever the remote is (probes with a valid carried approval pushed to protected branches until the text said so). No rule text was removed to pay for these. Worst idle+nonok+handoff-partial+driver+question+question-timeout+resumed+auto-mode: 6,141 chars, 6,151 with a 16-character plugin name; the 10,000 cutoff stays hard.

resume block total.why: The resume protocol above beside the 3,000 B measured block (whose plugin line may also say an install replaced the session's copy, inside that block). The runtime cap is 9,500 chars (resumeblock.pm $MAX_CHARS, resume.ts BLOCK_MAX), under the hard 10,000 SessionStart cutoff, and a block over 6,500 logs resume_block_over_soft. Worst idle+nonok+handoff-partial+driver+question+question-timeout+resumed+auto-mode: 9,357 chars, 9,367 with a 16-character plugin name, under the unchanged 9,500 runtime cap.

asset resume-context.txt.why: AT-W-02 counts every tag line of the resume context, so it grows with the resume protocol above: both step-4 lines (each with the protected-branch wording), every idle line ([idle], [idle-halt], [idle-done], and the one-line [idle-off] and [idle-done-off] forms used while idle_digest is off, since the away digest ships on only after a live pass; a block carries at most one idle line), the [idle-again] note, the [driver] re-enter line with its workflow-file condition, the [handoff-ack] and [question] lines with their provenance notes, [auto-mode], [resumed], [question-timeout] and step 6's no-dialog clause: 8,717 B, 8,722 B with a 16-character plugin name.

static core.why: The static core stays soft and the mod channel total hard (raised from 8,192 B to 8,991 B to pay for this text; the classic channel total stays 8,192 B). It carries the Approvals line, scoped to the items the answer names (for a bare yes, its question's items), the [queue] line, the production write in the gate list, the foreign-command tag, the dialog answer as an approval source, the lines on asks, approval scope, relative limits, gotchas, question statuses, overlapped tests and follow-ups, an ask's latest status on copy, the lane Status words with the blocked meaning and the todo|done mark of each Next step, a saved handoff's one-line report (`✓ Handoff saved: <path>` then ` · Needs you: <n> questions`, so a user-run handoff cut off by a compaction still says how many questions are open), and the wait mark of a todo step held on a running job's result or on the user (` · waits: job|you · todo`, so code reads the lane's soft- and hard-blocked state from the mark, not the step's words). Worst midturn+chain+handoff+queue: 5,419 chars, 5,434 with a 16-character plugin name; the classic static core paths go over the soft 4,500 too, under the classic channel total.

asset skills/resume/SKILL.md.why: The resume skill holds Rule 2's own/foreign command rule with its real-risk list; Rule 3's scoped approvals with the explicit-gate list, which asks even when an approval carries, names the protected branches and, in auto permission mode, the classes the classifier still blocks; R9's stops 5-6 with resume_proceed and its Active driver re-entry (only a driver its session still shows active is run; a loop that paused itself is shown, never run); R3's `Driver now` and `Approvals (context only, re-ask)` lines and the reconcile's this-worktree-only rewrite; R4's handoff-resume pin line; R7's carried production read; the plugin-root and session-id fallbacks of the <store> line; R8's verdict, the agent decisions of the handoff's own session, its first item under resume_proceed and its no-dialog-after-a-timeout clause; Rule 1's pointer-is-not-proof; R5's not-checked probe and its lifecycle sentences (/clear keeps background shells, agents, workflows, teammates and crons; "Move to background and exit" passes on only shells, agents and workflows and ends teammates and session-only crons, while a durable cron survives it; resumeFromRunId needs the original conversation); the light path's handoff ack clause; the default handoff root ~/.local/state/<plugin>/handoffs with the pre-0.1.2 ~/.claude/handoffs read only; and R6's note that a `pruned` MANIFEST row was deleted on purpose. Trimming back to 21,504 B would cut that text or the helper-output descriptions R1, R3, R5 and R6 rely on; the intro's overview sentence and several reason clauses were already cut to pay for part of it. 24,280 B, 24,310 B with a 16-character plugin name.
